name: aster-share
description: Aster is the easiest way to turn your work into a private, shareable link. Its Mac app publishes recordings and artifacts as live web pages, with zero-knowledge encryption: content is decrypted in the browser and never sits readable on a server. Links expire after 30 days. This connector brings that into Claude. Pass it an HTML artifact and it returns a public link to share, plus a private admin link to manage or delete it.

_published_faq.name: How do I add aster-share to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add aster-share to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://share.asterlabs.app/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is aster-share MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, aster-share scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, aster-share scores 84/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 1 of 1 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to aster-share in business-productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Pyth, Domhaul, Idiolect AI, aquent-jobs, and Aisle Wedding.
